Horizn Studios KI Agent · AI says:
Return period: EU/UK customers have a 14-day statutory withdrawal right, plus all customers benefit from a 30-day voluntary return right from receipt of goods. Items must be unused, complete, and in original packaging.
How to return: Register your return in advance via the 👉 Return Portal. You can:
Use our prepaid label (a return fee may be deducted depending on country),
Use your own carrier at your cost,
Or return for free in person at our Flagship Stores (for online orders).
Exchanges: Direct exchanges are not possible; please return the item and place a new order.
Refunds: Once your return reaches our warehouse and is inspected, we refund to the original payment method, usually within 8 business days (bank processing may add a few days). Shipping costs are refunded only if the entire order is returned and only up to the cheapest standard shipping.
Return fees: If you use our label, a flat fee per package is deducted (EU mainland: €5 per package, max €15; UK: £20, max £60; CH: CHF 20, max CHF 60). Outside these regions, you organise and pay for the return yourself. 👉 Return Portal
Defective products: If you return an item due to a defect, we cover the return shipping in full after reviewing your case.
Special notes:
Personalised items are excluded from returns; if returned with an order, their price will not be refunded.
If the 30-day window has passed, we may make an exception only for completely unused items in original packaging.
If you registered a return but decide to keep the item, simply don’t ship it back; the registration expires automatically.
Incomplete refunds may result from staged processing of multiple packages, deduction of return fees, Switzerland-specific rules, or discount conditions no longer being met.
